module_summary: Multi-cycle RV32 core: a one-hot main FSM sequences fetch, decode, register read, ALU execute, shift and load/store through a shared memory-bus FSM, with optional PCPI co-processor, IRQ and counters.

anchors.name: cpu_state
anchors.why: One-hot main FSM: fetch, ld_rs1, ld_rs2, exec, shift, stmem, ldmem, trap; sequences entire core.

anchors.name: cpuregs
anchors.why: 32x32 general-purpose register file (plus IRQ q-registers), read for operands, written at writeback.

anchors.name: reg_pc
anchors.why: Program counter of the executing instruction; updated at fetch from next_pc.

anchors.name: alu_out
anchors.why: Combinational ALU result: add/sub, logic ops, shifts, compares from reg_op1/reg_op2.

anchors.name: mem_valid
anchors.why: Native memory bus request valid for instruction fetch, load and store.

anchors.name: mem_ready
anchors.why: Memory acknowledge; completes the transfer and advances memory FSM.

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Memory bus address, from next_pc for fetch or reg_op1 for data access.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Memory read data: instruction words for decoder and load data.

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Store data driven to memory, byte/halfword replicated from reg_op2.

anchors.name: mem_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte write strobes for stores; zero for reads.

anchors.name: mem_instr
anchors.why: Marks current memory transfer as an instruction fetch.

anchors.name: mem_state
anchors.why: Memory interface FSM: idle, read, write, prefetch-done; drives mem_valid and latching.

anchors.name: mem_do_rinst
anchors.why: Main FSM request to fetch an instruction; also starts decoding when done.

anchors.name: mem_do_rdata
anchors.why: Main FSM request for a data load transfer.

anchors.name: mem_do_wdata
anchors.why: Main FSM request for a data store transfer.

anchors.name: mem_do_prefetch
anchors.why: Requests speculative fetch of next instruction while executing.

anchors.name: mem_done
anchors.why: Memory transfer completion; advances main FSM and decoder triggers.

anchors.name: mem_xfer
anchors.why: Accepted beat: valid&ready or use of prefetched high halfword.

anchors.name: mem_wordsize
anchors.why: Selects word/half/byte for write strobes, wdata replication and rdata extraction.

anchors.name: mem_rdata_q
anchors.why: Latched memory read data; feeds second-stage decode and load result.

anchors.name: mem_rdata_latched
anchors.why: Realigned fetch word (compressed halfword handling) fed to first-stage decoder.

anchors.name: mem_la_read
anchors.why: Look-ahead read request one cycle before mem_valid.

anchors.name: mem_la_write
anchors.why: Look-ahead write request one cycle before mem_valid.

anchors.name: mem_la_addr
anchors.why: Look-ahead address: next_pc for fetch, reg_op1 for data.

anchors.name: mem_16bit_buffer
anchors.why: Holds upper halfword for misaligned/compressed instruction fetches.

anchors.name: prefetched_high_word
anchors.why: Indicates mem_16bit_buffer holds a valid prefetched high halfword.

anchors.name: mem_la_secondword
anchors.why: Second fetch of an instruction straddling a word boundary.

anchors.name: decoder_trigger
anchors.why: Fetch completed; enables second-stage decode of mem_rdata_q into instr/decoded registers.

anchors.name: decoder_pseudo_trigger
anchors.why: Re-runs decode without new fetch, e.g. after IRQ or PCPI retry.

anchors.name: next_insn_opcode
anchors.why: Fetched instruction word; used for PCPI pcpi_insn and debug.

anchors.name: decoded_rd
anchors.why: Destination register index from decode, latched to latched_rd.

anchors.name: decoded_rs1
anchors.why: Source register 1 index addressing cpuregs read port.

anchors.name: decoded_rs2
anchors.why: Source register 2 index addressing cpuregs second read port.

anchors.name: decoded_imm
anchors.why: Decoded sign-extended immediate loaded into operands or next PC.

anchors.name: instr_trap
anchors.why: No valid instruction decoded: illegal instruction, routes to PCPI or trap.

anchors.name: is_lb_lh_lw_lbu_lhu
anchors.why: Load-class decode flag steering exec to ldmem.

anchors.name: is_sb_sh_sw
anchors.why: Store-class decode flag steering FSM to stmem.

anchors.name: is_beq_bne_blt_bge_bltu_bgeu
anchors.why: Branch-class decode flag; uses alu_out_0 for taken decision.

anchors.name: is_alu_reg_imm
anchors.why: Register-immediate ALU op class; selects decoded_imm as op2.

anchors.name: compressed_instr
anchors.why: Decoded instruction is 16-bit RVC; PC increments by 2.

anchors.name: launch_next_insn
anchors.why: Fetch state ready to dispatch next instruction (no IRQ pending).

anchors.name: reg_next_pc
anchors.why: Next sequential or jump target PC; source of fetch address.

anchors.name: current_pc
anchors.why: Resolved PC at fetch; link value for JAL/IRQ return address.

anchors.name: reg_op1
anchors.why: ALU operand 1 from rs1/PC; also load/store address and shift operand.

anchors.name: reg_op2
anchors.why: ALU operand 2 from rs2 or immediate; store data source.

anchors.name: reg_out
anchors.why: Result register: load data, PCPI result, counters, link address for writeback.

anchors.name: reg_sh
anchors.why: Remaining shift amount for multi-cycle shift state.

anchors.name: alu_out_0
anchors.why: Comparison result: branch taken and slt outputs.

anchors.name: alu_add_sub
anchors.why: Adder/subtractor waypoint feeding alu_out.

anchors.name: alu_shl
anchors.why: Barrel-shifter left result waypoint.

anchors.name: alu_shr
anchors.why: Barrel-shifter right logical/arithmetic result waypoint.

anchors.name: alu_out_q
anchors.why: Registered ALU result used for writeback when latched_stalu set.

anchors.name: alu_wait
anchors.why: Stalls exec one cycle for two-cycle ALU/compare configurations.

anchors.name: latched_store
anchors.why: Writeback pending: enables register file write at next fetch.

anchors.name: latched_branch
anchors.why: Taken branch/jump: next_pc taken from reg_out instead of reg_next_pc.

anchors.name: latched_stalu
anchors.why: Selects alu_out_q versus reg_out as writeback data.

anchors.name: latched_is_lu
anchors.why: Selects unsigned load extension in ldmem.

anchors.name: latched_rd
anchors.why: Writeback destination register index into cpuregs.

anchors.name: cpuregs_write
anchors.why: Register file write enable at writeback in fetch state.

anchors.name: cpuregs_wrdata
anchors.why: Writeback data mux: reg_pc link, alu_out_q, reg_out or IRQ return PC.

anchors.name: cpuregs_rs1
anchors.why: Register file read port 1 feeding reg_op1 and pcpi_rs1.

anchors.name: cpuregs_rs2
anchors.why: Register file read port 2 feeding reg_op2 and pcpi_rs2.

anchors.name: trap
anchors.why: Core halted in trap state on illegal instruction or misalignment.

anchors.name: count_cycle
anchors.why: 64-bit cycle counter read by rdcycle/rdcycleh.

anchors.name: count_instr
anchors.why: 64-bit retired-instruction counter read by rdinstr/rdinstrh.

anchors.name: is_rdcycle_rdcycleh_rdinstr_rdinstrh
anchors.why: Counter-read instruction class; selects counter value into reg_out.

anchors.name: irq_state
anchors.why: IRQ entry sequencer: saves return PC and pending mask into q-registers.

anchors.name: irq_pending
anchors.why: Latched pending interrupt vector from irq inputs and timer.

anchors.name: irq_mask
anchors.why: Software interrupt mask set by maskirq instruction.

anchors.name: irq_active
anchors.why: Interrupt handler running; blocks nesting until retirq.

anchors.name: irq_delay
anchors.why: Delays IRQ entry after retirq or branch.

anchors.name: timer
anchors.why: Down-counting timer set by timer instruction; raises IRQ 0 on expiry.

anchors.name: do_waitirq
anchors.why: waitirq instruction stalls core until an interrupt is pending.

anchors.name: irq
anchors.why: 32 external interrupt request lines latched into irq_pending.

anchors.name: eoi
anchors.why: End-of-interrupt vector of serviced IRQs.

anchors.name: pcpi_valid
anchors.why: Offers unknown instruction and rs1/rs2 to co-processor.

anchors.name: pcpi_ready
anchors.why: Co-processor completed instruction; result available.

anchors.name: pcpi_rd
anchors.why: Co-processor result written back to rd.

anchors.name: pcpi_wr
anchors.why: Co-processor requests register writeback of pcpi_rd.

anchors.name: pcpi_insn
anchors.why: Instruction word presented to co-processor.

anchors.name: pcpi_int_ready
anchors.why: Merged ready from external PCPI and internal mul/div units.

anchors.name: pcpi_int_rd
anchors.why: Merged co-processor result selected from responding unit.

anchors.name: pcpi_timeout
anchors.why: No co-processor accepted instruction in time; raises illegal-instruction trap.

anchors.name: pcpi_timeout_counter
anchors.why: Counts cycles waiting for PCPI wait/ready response.

anchors.name: trace_valid
anchors.why: Trace word valid for retired instruction results.

anchors.name: trace_data
anchors.why: Trace payload: writeback value or branch/address/IRQ tag.

groups.name: main_controller
groups.description: One-hot instruction-sequencing FSM with writeback/branch latches and trap.

groups.name: fetch_decode
groups.description: Two-stage decoder producing instr_* flags, register indices and immediate from fetched word.

groups.name: register_file
groups.description: 32-entry register file with writeback mux and two read ports.

groups.name: execute_datapath
groups.description: PC registers, operand registers, ALU, shifter and result register.

groups.name: memory_interface
groups.description: Memory FSM serving fetch, load and store requests on native and look-ahead bus.

groups.name: compressed_fetch_buffer
groups.description: Halfword buffer realigning compressed and word-straddling instruction fetches.

groups.name: pcpi_interface
groups.description: Co-processor offload of unknown instructions with result merge and timeout.

groups.name: irq_controller
groups.description: Interrupt latching, masking, timer and handler entry/return sequencing.

groups.name: perf_counters
groups.description: 64-bit cycle and instruction-retired counters readable by rdcycle/rdinstr.

groups.name: trace_port
groups.description: Instruction trace output of writeback values and branch targets.
